sect1.title: Input File
sect1.para: This is navigator to find the input file tags

sect1.title: How to write the input file
sect1.para: The input file consists of key-value pairs where each key represents a specific setting. Each parameter should be written in the following format:
Lines beginning with # or ! are considered as comments and they would be ignored.
Tags in this section is about simulatation parameters such as file path, numerical parameters.
This tags are used for adjusting Qubit Hamiltonian and qubit inital state. The format is the following:

para.bold: Case1.< > qubitfile tag : : Only single-qubit systems are supported. Note that this tag takes priority over the Qubit tag.

bold.bold: Case2.< > Qubit tag : Both multiple qubit and single system are supported.

details.summary: Example: Click here to show example code

bold.bold: Below are the descriptions of various configuration tags used in the input file.
Description: CCE Methods to calculate the dynamics of the system.

Options: | Option | Description | Reference | |------|----------------------------------| | CCE | Conventional CCE method | | gCCE | Generalized CCE method | | pCCE | Partition CCE method | | Dsj | Disjoint method | | Itb | Inter bath method | | Dsjitb| Disjoint + Inter bath method |
Description: Quantity to calculate the dynamics of the system.
Description: Order of the CCE method.
Data Type: Float or Float List
Description: Number of state templates to be generated.

entry.para: No state template will be generated (Ensemble approach)
State template will be generated (Single-sample approach) Mean-field effect will be automatically added

bold.bold: Description: Seed for random number generator. If you want to generate the same state templates, you should set the same seed value.
Description: File path of the qubit spatial configuration. This tag is required when you use the qubit configuration file. Also, this only supports for a single qubit system.

bold.preformatted: example) 10.0 12.0 13.0 - x,y,z position of qubit in cartesian, angstrom

bold.bold: Description: File name including bath spin information, e.g. gyromagnetic ratio, spin number

bold.preformatted: File format is the following : [Name] [SpinNumber] [Gyromagnetic ratio (rad/ms/G)]

bold.bold: Description: File name of the bath spatial configuration.

bold.preformatted: example) 1.0 0.0 0.0 0.0 - Total line number 1.0 2.0 3.0 13C - x,y,z in cartesian, angstrom 4.0 5.0 6.0 P1 - Spin name should be the same to the name in gyrofile

bold.bold: Data Type: String (File path) or String List

Description: Adjust the bath configuration. If you want to adjust the bath configuration, you can set the bathadjust value. Usually, this tag is required for multiple qubit calculation that wouldb have different bath configuration

Description: File path of the principal axis of the bath spin. This tag might require during paramagnetic defect bath simulation. During PM defect bath simulation, if you don\'t give this file, the principal axes are automatically assigned.

bold.preformatted: File format is the following : [Principal axis index]
example) 5.0 - The number of total line 1.0 - principal axis index 2.0 - : 3.0 3.0

bold.bold: Description: File name of the bath state template. This tag might require when you want to obtain the result for a certain set of initial bath state. If the file path of the statefile doesn\'t exist, the program will automatically generate the state template.

bold.preformatted: example) 5.0 - The number of total line -0.5 - Spin sublevel when S=1/2 0.5 - : -0.5 -0.5

bold.bold: Description: File name of the additional bath spin state template. This tag might require when you want to calculate paramagnetic defect bath. Each bath state represent the additional bath spin state. If the file path of the exstatefile doesn\'t exist, the program will automatically generate the state template.

bold.preformatted: example) 5.0 - The number of total line -1.0 - Spin sublevel when S=1 0.0 - : 1.0 -1.0

bold.bold: Description: Total spin number of the qubit. (Required when you use Hyperfine tensor file obtained by QUANTUM ESPRESSO)
Description: Spin number correction (Required when you use Hyperfine tensor file obtained by QUANTUM ESPRESSO)
Description: Interaction tensor between qubit and bath spins can be determined by this option. If you want to use the hyperfine tensor obtained from DFT calculation, you should set this option.
Description: File name of the hyperfine tensor. This tag is required when you use the hyperfine tensor obtained from DFT calculation.

Description: Qubit information. This tag is required to give the details of qubit information.

para.bold: Description: Number of qubits in the system. The number of qubit information in tag Qubit should be the same as this value.
Description: Qubit information details, e.g. qubit name, spin number, gyro magnetic ratio, etc.. This tag is required to give the details of qubit information.

listitem.para: xyz : x,y,z position of qubit in cartesian, angstrom

para.bold: Description: Spin number of the qubit.
Description: Gyromagnetic ratio of the qubit.
Description: x,y,z position of the qubit in cartesian coordinates.
Description: Detuning frequency of the qubit.

Description: Alpha state of the qubit. Represents one of the effective spin states of the qubit. Priority: psia > alphaidx > alphams. This tag is ultimately applied to set QubitArray::psia (i.e. psia), unless it is overridden by a higher-priority tag

Description: Beta state of the qubit. One of the effective spin states of the qubit. Priority: psib > betaidx > betams. This tag is ultimately applied to set QubitArray::psib (i.e. psib), unless it is overridden by a higher-priority tag
Description: Interaction map between qubits. This tag is required to define the interaction map between qubits, including its self interaction (e.g. Zero-field splitting).

Description: Names of an interacting qubit pair. This tag is required to define the interaction map for a specific qubit pair. For zero-field splitting interactions, the qubit names must be identical. (e.g. ["q1","q1"] )
Description: Interaction tensor. This tag is required to define the interaction tensor for a specific qubit pair. This tensor is used to calculate the interaction between qubits.

Description: Alpha state of the qubit in matrix representation. One of the effective spin states of the qubit in matrix representation, simbol : $ |\alpha\rangle $ . Priority: psia > alphaidx > alphams.
Default: - (If not entered, alphams state would be the )
Description: Beta state of the qubit in matrix representation. One of the effective spin states of the qubit in matrix representation, simbol : $ |\beta\rangle $ . Priority: psib > betaidx > betams.

Description: Initial state of the qubit in matrix representation, symbol: $ |\psi_0\rangle $ This tag is used to define a specific initial state of the qubit. If this tag is not provided, the initial state defaults to $ |\psi_0\rangle = |\alpha\rangle + |\beta\rangle $.
Description: Overhauser field of the qubit. This tag is required to compute spin dynamics including the Overhauser field of the qubit.

Description: Alpha state of the qubit. (Adiabatic state of the qubit system) Use this tag to assign the eigenvector of the diagonalized qubit Hamiltonian as the initial qubit state. Priority: psia > alphaidx > alphams. This tag is ultimately applied to set QubitArray::psia (i.e. psia), unless it is overridden by a higher-priority tag

Description: Beta state of the qubit. (Adiabatic state of the qubit system) Use this tag to assign the eigenvector of the diagonalized qubit Hamiltonian as the initial qubit state. Priority: psib > betaidx > betams. This tag is ultimately applied to set QubitArray::psib (i.e. psib), unless it is overridden by a higher-priority tag
